body.text: Cittotpādasaṃvaravidhikramaḥ
body.translated_text: <s>Cittotpāda-saṃvara-vidhikrama</s> (Procedure for the Ritual of Generating the Awakening Mind and Taking the Vow)

body.text: namo mañjuśriye kumārabhūtāya

children.translated_text: Fallen from all lower births and devoid of all obscurations—
I pay homage to <s>bodhicitta</s> (the mind of awakening), which grants the state of a Perfectly Awakened One. // 1 //
The Perfectly Awakened One, the True <s>Dharma</s>, and the host of <s>Bodhisattvas</s> also—
I write the proper sequence of the <s>bodhisattva</s> vow (<s>saṃvara</s>). // 2 //

body.text: tatra prathamaṃ sarvabuddha-bodhisattvavandanā-pūjādi-vidhipūrvakam, kalyāṇamitre śāstṛsaṃjñām utpādya evam adhyeṣitavyam- yathā pūrvatathāgatārhat-samyaksambuddhaiḥ mahābhūmisthitabodhisattvaiśca pūrvam anuttarasamyaksambodhau cittotpādaḥ kṛtaḥ tathā evaṃ nāmno mamāpi ācāryo 'nuttarasamyaksambodhau cittam utpādayed iti triḥ vadet /
body.translated_text: First, after performing the preliminary rites of homage, offerings, and the like to all <s>Buddhas</s> and <s>Bodhisattvas</s>, having generated the perception of the spiritual friend (<s>kalyāṇamitra</s>) as teacher, one should petition thus: 'Just as the previous <s>Tathāgatas</s>, <s>Arhats</s>, Perfectly Awakened Ones, and the great <s>Bodhisattvas</s> who have entered the great stages (<s>bhūmi</s>) previously generated the mind of unsurpassed perfect awakening (<s>anuttara-samyak-sambodhi</s>), so too may the <s>ācārya</s> (teacher) generate in me, named so-and-so, the mind of unsurpassed perfect awakening.' This should be said three times.

body.text: evam adhyeṣya triśaraṇagamanam- samanvāhara ācārya / ahamevaṃnāmā etatkālaprabhṛti yāvadbodhimaṇḍaṃ dvipadānāṃ śreṣṭhaṃ buddhaṃ bhagavantaṃ śaraṇaṃ gacchāmi / samanvāhara ācārya / ahamevaṃnāmā etatkālaprabhṛti yāvadbodhimaṇḍaṃ dharmāṇāmuttamaṃ śāntavirāgaṃ dharma śaraṇaṃ gacchāmi / samanvāhara ācārya / ahamevaṃnāmā etatkālaprabhṛti yāvadbodhimaṇḍaṃ gaṇānāmuttamaṃ āryabodhisattvāvaivartikabodhisattvasaṃghaṃ śaraṇaṃ gacchāmi iti triḥ vadet /
body.translated_text: Having thus petitioned, the taking of the three refuges (<s>triśaraṇagamana</s>): 'Attend, <s>ācārya</s>! I, named so-and-so, from this moment until the seat of awakening (<s>bodhimaṇḍa</s>), go for refuge to the <s>Buddha</s>, the <s>Bhagavat</s>, foremost among bipeds. Attend, <s>ācārya</s>! I, named so-and-so, from this moment until the seat of awakening, go for refuge to the <s>Dharma</s>, the supreme, peaceful and passionless. Attend, <s>ācārya</s>! I, named so-and-so, from this moment until the seat of awakening, go for refuge to the <s>Saṅgha</s>, the supreme among assemblies, the community of noble <s>Bodhisattvas</s> who are non-retrogressing (<s>avaivartika</s>).' This should be said three times.

body.text: evaṃ viśiṣṭaṃ śaraṇagamanaṃ kṛttvā bhagavantaṃ śākyamuniṃ, daśadiśāṃ sarvabuddhān bodhisattvāṃśca manasā ālambya praṇamanaṃ yathālabdhaṃ pūjādikaṃ ca kuryāt / ācāryam sammukhaṃ kṛtvā dakṣiṇaṃ jānumaṇḍalaṃ pṛthivyāṃ pratiṣṭhāpya utkuṭukāsano 'pi vā kṛtāñjaliḥ cittam utpādayet /
body.translated_text: Having thus taken this distinguished refuge, one should mentally focus upon the <s>Bhagavat</s> <s>Śākyamuni</s> and all the <s>Buddhas</s> and <s>Bodhisattvas</s> of the ten directions, bow down, and make whatever offerings are available. Facing the <s>ācārya</s>, placing the right knee on the ground, or sitting in a squatting posture, with palms joined, one should generate the mind [of awakening]:

body.text: daśadigavasthitāḥ sarve buddhabodhisattvāḥ! mām samanvāharata / ācārya! samanvāhara / ahamevaṃnāmā- asyāṃ jātāvanyāsu vā jātiṣvanavarāgre vā dāna-śīla-bhāvanāyaṃ kuśalamūlaṃ mayā kṛtaṃ syāt kāritaṃ kriyamāṇaṃ vā anumoditaṃ bhavet taiḥ kuśalamūlaiḥ yathā pūrvakaiḥ tathāgatārhatsamyaksambuddhaiḥ mahābhūmipraviṣṭaiḥ mahābodhisattvaiśca anuttarasaṃyaksambodhau cittamutpāditaṃ tathā evaṃnāmā ahamapi etatkālaprabhṛti yāvadbodhimaṇḍaṃ anuttarasamyakmahāsambodhau cittam utpādayeyam / atīrṇān sattvān tārayeyam / amuktasattvān mocayeyam / anāśvastān āśvāsayeyam / aparinirvṛtān parinirvāpayeyam / evaṃ triḥ vadet /
body.translated_text: 'All <s>Buddhas</s> and <s>Bodhisattvas</s> dwelling in the ten directions, attend to me! <s>Ācārya</s>, attend! I, named so-and-so—whatever wholesome roots I may have created, caused to be created, or am creating in this birth or in other births, through giving (<s>dāna</s>), moral conduct (<s>śīla</s>), or meditation (<s>bhāvanā</s>), whether in the past or the present, and those I have rejoiced in—by those wholesome roots, just as the previous <s>Tathāgatas</s>, <s>Arhats</s>, Perfectly Awakened Ones, and the great <s>Bodhisattvas</s> who have entered the great stages generated the mind of unsurpassed perfect awakening, so too may I, named so-and-so, from this moment until the seat of awakening, generate the mind of unsurpassed great perfect awakening! May I ferry across beings who have not crossed over! May I liberate beings who are not liberated! May I give comfort to those who are not comforted! May I lead to complete <s>nirvāṇa</s> those who have not yet attained <s>parinirvāṇa</s>!' This should be said three times.

body.text: tathaiva ācāryābhāve 'pi svayaṃ bodhicittotpādavidhiḥ- tathāgataśākyamuniṃ daśadiksarvatathāgatāṃśca manasā vicintya vandanā-pūjādividhiṃ ca kṛtvā adhyeṣaṇāsahitamācāryapadavirahitaśaraṇagamanādikramaṃ pūrvavad niṣpādayet / evaṃ utpannacittaḥ pudgalaḥ bodhicittavṛddhyartha antaśo divā trivāraṃ rātrau ca trivāraṃ-
body.translated_text: Likewise, the procedure for generating <s>bodhicitta</s> on one's own, in the absence of an <s>ācārya</s>: mentally contemplating the <s>Tathāgata</s> <s>Śākyamuni</s> and all the <s>Tathāgatas</s> of the ten directions, having performed the rites of homage and offerings, one should complete the sequence of refuge-taking with the petition but omitting the term '<s>ācārya</s>,' as before. The person who has thus generated the mind, for the growth of <s>bodhicitta</s>, should recite at least three times during the day and three times during the night:

children.text: buddhaṃ ca dharmañca gaṇottamaṃ ca yāvaddhi bodhiṃ śaraṇaṃ gato 'smi /
dānādikṛtyaiśca kṛtairmayaibhiḥ buddho bhaveyaṃ jagato hitāya // 3 //
children.translated_text:
until awakening I have gone for refuge.
By the merit of my deeds of giving and the like,
may I become a <s>Buddha</s> for the benefit of the world.' // 3 //

body.text: iti bodhicittamutpādayet / bodhicittavyāghātakebhyaścaturbhyo rdharmebhyo vyāvṛtto bhavet / katame catvāraḥ? gurudakṣiṇīyavisaṃvādanam, pareṣu akaukṛtyasthānīyeṣu kaukṛtyopādanam, utpannacittebhyo bodhisattvebhyo dveṣeṇa avarṇabhāṣaṇam, sarvasattveṣu māyāśāṭhyācaraṇañca /
body.translated_text: Thus one should generate <s>bodhicitta</s>. And one should turn away from four <s>dharmas</s> that destroy <s>bodhicitta</s>. What are the four? Deceiving the <s>guru</s> and those worthy of reverence; causing remorse in others where there is no cause for remorse; speaking ill of <s>Bodhisattvas</s> who have generated the mind [of awakening] with hatred; and acting with deceit and cunning toward all sentient beings.

body.text: bodhicittāvyāghātakān caturdharmān śikṣeta / katamāṃścaturaḥ? jīvitasyāpi hetoḥ prajānan amṛṣāvādam, sarvasattveṣu adhyāśayaviśuddhyā sthitiḥ na māyāśāṭhyena, utpannacitteṣu bodhisattveṣu
body.translated_text: One should train in four <s>dharmas</s> that do not destroy <s>bodhicitta</s>. What are the four? Not speaking falsehood even at the cost of one's life, knowingly; abiding in purity of intention toward all sentient beings, not with deceit and cunning; toward <s>Bodhisattvas</s> who have generated the mind [of awakening],

body.text: śāstṛsaṃjñāmutpādya daśasu dikṣu samyagguṇākhyānam, ye sattvāḥ kuśale sthāpitāḥ teṣām anuttarasamyaksambodhau sthāpanaṃ na tu śrāvakapratyekabuddhatveṣviti /
body.translated_text: generating the perception of them as teachers and proclaiming their true qualities in the ten directions; and establishing those beings who have been placed in virtue in unsurpassed perfect awakening, and not in the vehicles of <s>Śrāvakas</s> or <s>Pratyekabuddhas</s>.

body.text: viśeṣeṇābhijñāṃ śīghraṃ labdhukāmo bodhisattvaḥ ārya-avalokiteśvara-paripṛcchā-saptadharmaka-nāma-mahāyānasūtraṃ śikṣeta / bodhicittotpādānuśaṃsā tu "gaṇḍavyūhasūtrā"-dibhyo jñātavyā /
body.translated_text: In particular, a <s>Bodhisattva</s> who wishes to quickly attain <s>abhijñā</s> (higher knowledge) should study the <s>Āryāvalokiteśvaraparipṛcchā-saptadharmaka-nāma-mahāyānasūtra</s> (The Noble Mahāyāna Sūtra Called the Question of Avalokiteśvara on Seven Dharmas). The benefits of generating <s>bodhicitta</s> (the awakening mind) should be understood from the <s>Gaṇḍavyūhasūtra</s> and other texts.

body.text: tatra prathamaṃ vidhivad utpannabodhicittasya bodhisattvasya sarvabodhisattvaśīlaśikṣāṃ suśikṣitukāmanayā bodhisattvaṃ bodhisattvasaṃvarasthitaṃ,bodhisattvasaṃvaravidhijñaṃ bodhisattvasaṃvarapradānena śiṣyānugrahasamartha kalyāṇamitraṃ namaskṛtya taccaraṇe nipatya adhyeṣaṇā- "ācārya! tavāhaṃ bodhisattvaśīlasaṃvarasamādānamākāṃkṣāmyādātuṃ tadarhasyanuparodhena muhūrtamasmākamanukampayā dātuṃ śrotuñca", "ityevaṃ trivāraṃ adhyeṣitavyam /
body.translated_text: Therein, first, the <s>Bodhisattva</s> in whom <s>bodhicitta</s> has been properly generated, wishing to train well in the training of all <s>Bodhisattva</s> precepts, should bow to a <s>kalyāṇamitra</s> (spiritual friend) — one who is a <s>Bodhisattva</s> established in the <s>Bodhisattva</s> vow, who knows the method of conferring the <s>Bodhisattva</s> vow, and who is capable of benefiting disciples by granting the <s>Bodhisattva</s> vow — and falling at his feet, make this request: 'O <s>Ācārya</s> (teacher)! I desire to receive the <s>Bodhisattva</s> moral discipline and vow from you. Please be so kind as to grant it and allow me to hear it, with compassion for me, for a moment without interruption.' Thus should the request be made three times.

body.text: "kulaputra! tvaṃ śrṛṇu / tvam evaṃ sattvān anuttīrṇān uttārya, amuktān mocayitvā, anāśvatān āśvāsya, aparinirvṛttān parinirvāpya, buddhavaṃśānucchedam icchasi? tatastvaṃ cittotpādadārḍhya samādānadārḍhyañca kuru / "na tvanyaiḥ saha pratispardhāhetave / nānyairbalād grāhito 'si? evaṃ pṛcchet /
body.translated_text: 'O son of good family! Listen. You who wish to ferry across those beings who have not crossed over, to liberate those who are not free, to comfort those who are not comforted, to lead to complete <s>nirvāṇa</s> those who have not attained <s>parinirvāṇa</s>, and to prevent the lineage of the <s>Buddhas</s> from being cut off — therefore, make firm your generation of <s>bodhicitta</s> and your resolve to undertake [the vow]! You are not doing this out of rivalry with others? You have not been forced by others?' Thus should one ask.

body.text: tatpaścāt tathāgataśākyamuneḥ niṣiktāṃ pratimāṃ paṭacitram vā purato 'vasthāpya tathāgataśākyamunyādīn daśadiksarvalokadhātvavasthitān sarvabuddhabodhisattvān purato bhāvayet / yathāśakti bāhyapañcapūjayā pūjāṃ vandanaṃ ca kuryāt /
body.translated_text: After that, having placed before oneself a consecrated image of the <s>Tathāgata</s> <s>Śākyamuni</s>, or a painting on cloth, one should visualize before oneself all the <s>Buddhas</s> and <s>Bodhisattvas</s> dwelling in all world-realms in the ten directions, beginning with the <s>Tathāgata</s> <s>Śākyamuni</s>. One should make worship and salutation with the external fivefold offering according to one's ability.

body.text: tadanantaraṃ kalyāṇamitram uccāsanasthitaṃ śāstṛsaṃjñayā namaskṛtya dakṣiṇaṃ jānumaṇḍalaṃ pṛthivyāṃ pratiṣṭhāpya utkuṭukāsanena vāpi kṛtāñjaliḥ kalyāṇamitraṃ bodhisattvasaṃvaragrahaṇāya evam adhyeṣayet-
body.translated_text: Immediately after that, having bowed to the <s>kalyāṇamitra</s> (spiritual friend) seated on a high seat, regarding him as the Teacher, one should kneel with the right knee touching the ground, or in a squatting posture, and with palms joined, should make this request to the <s>kalyāṇamitra</s> for the taking of the <s>Bodhisattva</s> vow:

body.text: "ācāryo bodhisattvaśīlasaṃvarasamādānaṃ me śīghraṃ dadātu" ityevaṃ trivāraṃ kalyāṇamitram adhyeṣeta / tataḥ kalyāṇamitra upaviṣṭa utthito vāpi saḥ bodhisattvasaṃvaragrāhakaṃ taṃ evaṃ paripṛcchet- "evaṃnāmā tvaṃ bodhisattvo 'si bodhau ca kṛtapraṇidhānaḥ / evaṃ pṛṣṭe sati tena grāhakabodhisattvenāpi āmeti pratijñātavyam" /
body.translated_text: 'May the <s>Ācārya</s> quickly grant me the <s>Bodhisattva</s> moral discipline and vow.' Thus should one request the <s>kalyāṇamitra</s> three times. Then the <s>kalyāṇamitra</s>, whether seated or standing, should question the one who is about to take the <s>Bodhisattva</s> vow: 'You, named so-and-so, are you a <s>Bodhisattva</s> who has made the vow for awakening?' When thus questioned, the <s>Bodhisattva</s> who is about to receive [the vow] should affirm 'Yes.'

body.text: tataḥ 'akṣayāprameyānuttarapuṇyamahānidhibhūtaḥ sarvabuddhaguṇaratnākaro bodhisattvasaṃvaro 'cireṇa adhigamyata' iti cintayan cittaprasādāt saharṣa tūṣṇībhūya kṛtāñjalistiṣṭhet /
body.translated_text: Then, thinking 'The <s>Bodhisattva</s> vow, which is an inexhaustible, immeasurable, unsurpassed great treasure-store of merit, the jewel-mine of all <s>Buddha</s> qualities, will soon be attained' — with mental clarity and joy, one should stand silently with palms joined.

body.text: atha sa kalyāṇamitraḥ trikālasarvabodhisattvasarvaśikṣāpadāni sarvañca śīlaṃsaṃvaraśīlaṃ , kuśaladharmasaṅgrāhakaśīlaṃ, sattvārthakriyāśīlañca samāsataḥ śiṣyam ababodhya- "sarvabodhisattvaśikṣāpadāni tāni ca sarvabodhisattvaśīlāni kiṃ mattaḥ gṛhītukāmo 'si" evaṃ śiṣyaṃ pṛcchet / tasmin tathā "gṛhītukāmo 'smi" iti pratijñāte sati bodhisattvasaṃvaro dātavyaḥ /
body.translated_text: Then that <s>kalyāṇamitra</s>, having briefly instructed the disciple in all the training rules of all <s>Bodhisattvas</s> of the three times and all the moral disciplines — the <s>saṃvaraśīla</s> (discipline of restraint), the <s>kuśaladharmasaṃgrāhakaśīla</s> (discipline of accumulating wholesome dharmas), and the <s>sattvārthakriyāśīla</s> (discipline of acting for the benefit of beings) — should ask the disciple: 'Do you wish to receive from me all the training rules of all <s>Bodhisattvas</s> and all the <s>Bodhisattva</s> moral disciplines?' When the disciple affirms 'I wish to receive them,' the <s>Bodhisattva</s> vow should be conferred.

body.text: tvamevaṃnāmā bhadanta āyuṣmān kulaputro vā mat bodhisattva ityeva saṃjñakāt "sarvāṇi bodhisattvaśikṣāpadāni sarvañca bodhisattvaśīlaṃ saṃvaraśīlaṃ kuśaladharmasaṃgrāhakaśīlaṃ sattvārthakriyāśīlañca / yāni śikṣāpadāni yacchīlamatītānāṃ sarvabodhisattvānāmabhūt / yāni śikṣāpadāni yacchīlamanāgatānāṃ sarvabodhisattvānāṃ bhaviṣyati / yāni śikṣāpadāni yacchīlametarhi daśasu dikṣu pratyutpannānāṃ sarvabodhisattvānāṃ bhavati / yeṣu śikṣāpadeśu yacchīle 'tītāḥ sarvabodhisattvāḥ śikṣitavantaḥ / anāgatāḥ sarvabodhisattvāḥ śikṣiṣyante / pratyutpannāḥ sarvabodhisattvāḥ śikṣante / tena pratigṛhṇāmīti pratijñātavyam" / evam ācāryeṇa trivāraṃ "grahīṣyasi kiṃ" iti uktvā śiṣyeṇa "ām sugṛhīṣyāmi" iti trivāraṃ abhihite saṃvaraṃ samādadyāt /
body.translated_text: 'You, named so-and-so, venerable one, elder, or son of good family — from me, the <s>Bodhisattva</s> so-designated: all the training rules of <s>Bodhisattvas</s> and all the <s>Bodhisattva</s> moral disciplines — the <s>saṃvaraśīla</s> (discipline of restraint), the <s>kuśaladharmasaṃgrāhakaśīla</s> (discipline of accumulating wholesome dharmas), and the <s>sattvārthakriyāśīla</s> (discipline of acting for the benefit of beings) — whatever training rules and whatever moral discipline the past <s>Bodhisattvas</s> had; whatever training rules and whatever moral discipline the future <s>Bodhisattvas</s> will have; whatever training rules and whatever moral discipline the present <s>Bodhisattvas</s> in the ten directions now have; in whatever training rules and whatever moral discipline the past <s>Bodhisattvas</s> trained; in which the future <s>Bodhisattvas</s> will train; in which the present <s>Bodhisattvas</s> are training — [the disciple] should affirm: "I accept them." Thus the <s>Ācārya</s>, having said three times "Will you accept?", and the disciple having replied three times "Yes, I will gladly accept" — should confer the vow.'

body.text: tataḥ sa kalyāṇamitraḥ śiṣyāya bodhisattvasaṃvaraṃ sattvā daśadiksarvabuddhabodhisattvebhyaḥ pañcāṅganamaskārapūrva kṛtāñjaliḥ evaṃ trivāraṃ vadet- "pratīgṛhītamanena evaṃnāmnā bodhisattvena mama evaṃnāmno bodhisattvasyāntikād yāvat trirapi bodhisattvaśīlasaṃvarasamādānam / so 'hamevaṃnāmātmānaṃ sākṣibhūtamasyaitannāmno bodhisattvasya paramāryāṇāṃ viparokṣāṇāmapi sarvatra sarvasattvāviparokṣabuddhīnāṃ daśasu dikṣvanantāparyanteṣu lokadhātuṣvārocayāmyasmin bodhisattvaśīlasaṃvarasamādānam" / iti trivāraṃ
daśadiksabuddhabodhisattvebhya uktvā, namaskṛtya ca guruśiṣyau uttiṣṭhetām /"

tata utthāya kalyāṇamitraḥ bodhisattvasaṃvaragrāhakaṃ bodhisattvam evaṃ brūyāt- "evaṃnāma bodhisattva! tvaṃ śṛṇu- iyaṃ hi dharmatā / yadā bodhisattvena bodhisattvasaṃvarasamādānakarmavācanā parisampādyate tadā daśadiksarvabuddhakṣetreṣu buddhabodhisattveṣu etādṛṅnimittāni prādurbhavanti / te buddhabodhisattvā evaṃ kasmiṃścid buddhakṣetre evaṃnāmā bodhisattva evaṃnāmno bodhisattvād bodhisattvasaṃvarasamādānaṃ gṛhṇāti iti saṃjānanti" / ataḥ te bhagavanto buddhā te ca bodhisattvā dharmasnehāt putrān bhrātṛkāniva sandadhate / tathā sandhānāt puṇyajñānasambhāravṛddhirbhaviṣyatīti vaktavyam /

atha tena kalyāṇamitreṇa sa bodhisattva evaṃ vaktvyaḥ / evaṃnāmabodhisattva / tvaṃ śṛṇu / bodhisattvasaṃvarasamādānamidaṃ aśraddadhānānām agre na vācyam / yato 'śraddhebhyo bodhisattvasaṃvarapradarśane aśraddadhānā sattvāste bodhisattvasaṃvaraṃ aśraddhayā parityajanti / ato yāvad bodhisattvo bodhisattvasaṃvarasthitaḥ puṇyarāśiyukto bhavati tāvad aśraddhayā sa tenaiva apuṇyarāśinā ca yukto bhavati / yato bodhisattvaḥ sattvān sarvaduḥkhebhyaḥ parirakṣati anyāṃśca pāpebhyo nivārayati / ataḥ sakuśalo bodhisattvo gopāyati /

atha śikṣāpadapārājikasthānabhūtān saṃvaranāśahetūn darśayitvā duṣkṛtān kliṣṭākliṣṭān api darśayet / kalyāṇamitraḥ samāsato 'bodhisattvasaṃvaraviṃśakam' tathā bodhisattvabhūmeḥ śīlaparivarttañca bhāṣeta /
bodhicittotpāda-bodhisattvasaṃvaravidhirmahācāryadīpaṅkaraśrījñāna-kṛtaḥ samāptaḥ //
tenaiva bhāratīyopādhyāyena mahāsaṃśodhakalokacakṣuṣā bhikṣu-kuśalamatinā (dge vai blo gros) cānūditaḥ //
punastenaiva paṇḍitena lokacakṣuṣā bhikṣu-jayaśīlena (chul khrims rgyal va) ca saṃśodhya nirṇītaḥ //
